title: Legend of Range Four Harry, the glowing radioactive horse

tellings.quote: The range, the legend of range for Harry was that there was this giant white radioactive horse

related.note: This is the same giant white horse as the Range Four Harry legend in #1, but Hall explains it as the tall whites' suit force fields merging, not a radioactive horse.

plain: On the Indian Springs gunnery ranges in Nevada in the mid-1960s, there was a legend about a giant white radioactive horse called Range Four Harry. A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among tall white aliens there, tells Michels about the legend from his own time on the ranges. In a related story, he ties the horse to the tall white beings moving in a fast "horse formation," which would mean the legend was really about them.
